description: Base schema for a Solargis data request - not used directly in public APIs. See special public request types derived from the base.

fromDate.description: Start date of the requested data. Inclusive. See also the utcOffset.

toDate.description: End date of the requested data. Inclusive. See also the utcOffset.

utcOffset.description: ISO 8601 time zone designator (offset from UTC) formatted as [±]hh:mm. Allows only whole hour or half-hour offsets in the range ±14:30. If this property is missing, the offset is derived from the site longitude as the nearest whole hour (longitude / 15), e.g. longitude 17.3 gives +01:00 and -100.0 gives -07:00. This is not the civil time zone of the site and it does not follow daylight saving time.

timeAlignment.description: Datetime strings (labels of time intervals) can be positioned or aligned with the start, center or end of the time interval (or the left edge, the middle and the right edge of the time interval).

terrainShading.description: This attribute affects all related parameters (e.g., GHI, DIF, DNI, GTI, PVOUT, TMOD except parameters with explicit _NOSHD suffix.)

gtiConfiguration.description: Object is required if at least one GTI related column is present in the array of columns.

pvConfiguration.description: Object is required if at least one PV output related column is present in the array of columns (PVOUT, TMOD).
pvConfiguration.$comment: One schema for every PV simulation engine; the engine is selected by the simulationEngine property.

stochasticGenerator.description: For 1, 5 and 10 minute time steps, the solar irradiation values can be synthetically generated from 15 minute data.

includeSurfaceAlbedoLongTerm.description: Include long-term average of surface albedo in the output dataset. The value is taken from the user request (if value is present) or from the Solargis database (if not provided by user). Only for SOLARGIS_JSON and SOLARGIS_PARQUET format.

includeHorizon.description: Include horizon object in the output dataset (used for shading). The value is taken from the user request (if value is present) or from the Solargis database (if not provided by user). Only for SOLARGIS_JSON and SOLARGIS_PARQUET format.

includeJsonData.description: Include data section in the dataset. If false, the data is provided elsewhere e.g., as file or URI, and dataset just holds the metadata. Only for SOLARGIS_JSON and SOLARGIS_PARQUET format.

includeModelUncertaintyYearly.description: Include details about the yearly model uncertainty in the processing section of the metadata.
includeModelUncertaintyYearly.$comment: For TMY datasets for other scenario than P50 (e.g., P90, P75, PXX...) the false value is ignored internally and the uncertainty details are always included in datasets.

outputRoundingLevel.description: Defines the decimal precision used for numeric output values in datasets.

includeForecastModelColumns.description: Next to the blended forecast, return each forecast model's values as separate columns: GHI, DNI, DIF, DHI and GTI with its components (with and without terrain shading), and LEADTIME, for those requested in columns. Named <column>_<model> (historical forecast: <column>_<model>_<leadPeriod>), e.g. GHI_IFS, GHI_ICONEU_D1, LEADTIME_NOWCAST_H1, with the model in the column metadata (forecastModel). Values are taken before blending, with the same terrain shading as the blended columns. The models are those the forecast blending scheme uses for this site (a regional scheme contributes only the models of the region the site is in); a model column is empty only where that model has no data for the site or time. Columns without forecastModel are the blended forecast; the models it blends are listed in the dataset metadata, processing.modules entry solargis/forecastBlending. Other columns (e.g. KT, PAR, meteo, PV) are not split per model. Applies only to the forecast part of a timeseries.

forecastBlendingScheme.description: Forecast blending scheme (NWP models and satellite nowcast) used instead of the default one for the site's region: either the name of a predefined scheme or an inline definition. Applies to the forecast part of a timeseries, live or historical; a date range with no forecast part is unaffected. A scheme none of whose models is available at the site is rejected. Models of the scheme without data for the site or period are left out and the blend uses the remaining ones. The models actually used are listed in the dataset metadata, processing.modules entry solargis/forecastBlending (properties scheme and models; an inline definition is reported as scheme CUSTOM and echoed as definition).

oneOf.description: Name of a predefined forecast blending scheme, e.g. DEFAULT.

forecastModels.description: Return the forecast models' own values instead of a blended forecast: each requested column that a forecast model provides (GHI, DNI, DIF, DHI and GTI with its components, with and without terrain shading, and LEADTIME) once per model, named <column>_<model> (historical forecast: <column>_<model>_<leadPeriod>), e.g. GHI_IFS, GHI_ICONEU_D1, with the model in the column metadata (forecastModel). No blended column is returned. ALL: every model available at the site for the requested period, in a historical forecast also within its sources, including the satellite nowcast (NOWCAST) where it reaches. A list names the models; a model that is not available is refused. Columns that depend on the forecast but have no per-model values, e.g. PVOUT, are refused; columns that do not depend on it (meteo, sun position) are returned once. The models delivered are listed in the processing module solargis/forecastModels.

allOf.$comment: forecastModels returns the models' own values, so it excludes a blending scheme and the per-model columns of the blend.

ForecastBlendingSchemeDefinition.description: Inline forecast blending scheme: steps applied in order to one running result, each refining the result of the steps before it. Typically a few OVERLAY steps lay the models down in increasing priority, a WEIGHTED_MEAN combines the main NWP models and a LEADTIME_TRANSITION blends the nowcast in for the first hours. A step whose model has no data for the site is skipped; a WEIGHTED_MEAN left with one model acts as an OVERLAY of it.

ForecastBlendingOverlayStep.description: Replace the running result with the model's values wherever the model has data.

ForecastBlendingWeightedMeanStep.description: Replace the running result with the weighted mean of the models, over the models with data at each time step. Weights are relative and need not sum to 100.

weights.description: Model -> relative weight, at least two models, e.g. {"IFS": 50, "ICONEU": 50}.

ForecastBlendingLeadtimeTransitionStep.description: Blend the model into the running result by the model's own lead time: the model alone up to startHours, linearly fading out over widthHours, the running result alone after that. Where the running result has no data the model is used as is. Typically the nowcast: {"type": "LEADTIME_TRANSITION", "model": "NOWCAST", "startHours": 2.0, "widthHours": 1.5}.

startHours.description: Lead time in hours up to which the model is used alone.

widthHours.description: Lead time span in hours over which the model's weight falls from 1 to 0.

ForecastModelName.description: Forecast model, named as forecastModel in the dataset column metadata, e.g. IFS, ICONEU, GFS, NOWCAST for the satellite-based nowcast. The set of models evolves with Solargis forecasting and is not fixed by this schema; an unknown model is rejected.
